else.reason: Only Registered rows give a current trading name; Cancelled or Deregistered rows produce no trading_name observation

field_mappings.transformation: Emit the trimmed BN_NAME text as a current trading name only when BN_STATUS equals the documented value Registered. Rows whose BN_STATUS is Cancelled or Deregistered produce no trading_name observation; the raw name is not presented as current.

field_mappings.semantic_evidence: The Australian Business Number (ABN) is a single
field_mappings.transformation: Trim BN_ABN, strip separators, and validate as a bare 11-digit ABN with checksum. Blank or suppressed (NULL) values produce no observation.

unmapped_fields.reason: The registration date definition ('The date by which the Business Name started') is not an unambiguous entity registration event for entity.date_registered, so no mapping is supported.
Cancellation date is a conditional lifecycle field, not a registration date, and no validity slot is established for the whole observation.
BN_STATUS is used only as a predicate for trading_name; its own status-to-enum equivalence to the canonical status enum is not established without a separate crosswalk.
Former state number is a historical identifier from a previous regulator and has no ontology counterpart.
Previous state of registration describes the earlier regulator, not the current business address, so it cannot populate address.state.
Register name is a constant register label with no ontology counterpart.
